submitted.rationale: Rutile CrSbO4 near Cr:Sb 1:1 is the known visible-light photoanode phase in this system, so I measured around it. Index 15 (Sb 0.52) gave the highest EQE (0.0279%). Index 21 (Sb 0.68) was almost the same at 0.0273%. Index 18 (Sb 0.59), between them, was lower at 0.0244%. The response is flat across the Sb-rich rutile region, and the stoichiometric composition comes out best among the three.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.0244% EQE, lower than both neighbors
Expected mixed Cr2O3 plus rutile phases with poorer transport. Not measured because the budget was limited.
